attributes.name: Brinebones
attributes.powers:
Brinebones is immune to the Electricity, Mental, and Poison traits. 

Before you act, randomly choose an occupied location. Each characters at that location must attempt a Dexterity or Acrobatics 14 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 2 Electricity damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4+1 Electricity damage.
